apps.description: The AI apps the organisation allows (the setting mcp.clients): only these can connect.

can_connect.description: Whether an AI app can connect as you now: the organisation is on, it allows at least one app, and you opted in.

opted_in.description: Whether you have opted in to AI apps acting for you over MCP: off until you do.

organisation_on.description: Whether an Owner has turned AI apps through MCP on for the organisation (the setting features.mcp, with a second approver).

set_at.description: When you last chose, if ever.
